headline: Transfer deadline day recap: Everton hopeful on Balogun deal, Enzo signs for Man City
description: We recap the latest news, rumors, done deals and reaction throughout Europe's transfer deadline day, up to the Premier League window closing at 6 p.m. ET.

headline: Man City sign Enzo Fernández from Chelsea for joint-record fee
description: Manchester City have signed Argentine World Cup winner Enzo Fernández from Chelsea for a Premier League record-equaling £125 million ($169m) fee.

headline: Chelsea fume after Monaco's Lamine Camara U-turn - sources
description: Chelsea have agreed a €55 million ($64m / £47m deal) with AS Monaco for midfielder Lamine Camara, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Tottenham sign Mykhailo Mudryk, Tosin Adarabioyo in double deal from Chelsea
description: Tottenham Hotspur have signed Mykhailo Mudryk on a season-long loan and Tosin Adarabioyo on a permanent deal from Chelsea, the club has announced,
